# dash0_dataset (Resource)

Manages a Dash0 dataset. Datasets are organization-level resources identified by an immutable slug.

~> **Note:** Destroying a dataset soft-deletes it. After 30 days the dataset and ALL its telemetry are purged permanently. Re-creating a dataset with the same slug within 30 days restores it.

The slug is set in `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` and cannot change: changing it replaces the dataset (destroy, then create under the new slug). `spec.permissions` and `spec.telemetryFilters` are not managed by this resource yet: they are ignored on create and when detecting drift. Spec settings you omit (retention, privacy options) keep the server's values without causing a diff.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a Dash0 dataset declaratively. A dataset is an isolated slice of
# telemetry with its own retention, privacy, and ingestion settings.
# Datasets are organization-level resources (no dataset scope).
#
# metadata.labels."dash0.com/id" is the dataset slug. It is required and
# cannot be changed after creation; changing it destroys and re-creates the
# dataset.
#
# Destroying the resource soft-deletes the dataset. After 30 days, the dataset
# and all of its telemetry are purged. Re-creating a dataset with the same
# slug within 30 days restores it.
resource "dash0_dataset" "staging" {
  dataset_yaml = <<-YAML
kind: Dash0Dataset
metadata:
  name: Staging
  labels:
    dash0.com/id: staging
spec:
  tracing:
    retention: 30d
  logging:
    retention: 60d
  geoLocation:
    endUserGeoLocationStorageStrategy: up_to_country
  ipAddresses:
    endUserIpAddressStorageStrategy: anonymize
  cardholderDataRedaction:
    enabled: true
  genAiAttributeRedaction:
    conversation: redact
    toolCalls: disabled
    errors: disabled
YAML
}

# The dataset slug, for use as the `dataset` of other resources.
output "staging_dataset_slug" {
  value = dash0_dataset.staging.id
}

# You can also load the YAML definition from a file:
#
# resource "dash0_dataset" "staging" {
#   dataset_yaml = file("${path.module}/datasets/staging.yaml")
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset_yaml` (String) The dataset definition in YAML format, with `kind: Dash0Dataset`, `metadata.name` for the display name, `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` for the slug, and optional `spec` settings. Server-managed metadata is stripped from the state on read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The dataset slug, taken from `metadata.labels["dash0.com/id"]` in `dataset_yaml`.
- `origin` (String) A unique identifier for the dataset, generated by the provider on creation. Null for datasets imported without an origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Datasets are organization-scoped, so the import ID is the dataset slug
# (the `dash0.com/id` label) — no dataset prefix.
terraform import dash0_dataset.staging staging
```
